name: Dive Deep
definition: Operational excellence requires hands-on leadership with a passion for detail. We dig down to the smallest details to gain a full understanding, which equips us to empower the right people and deliver results. No task is beneath us.

rows.situation: When the number comes from someone else's dashboard
rows.under: Quotes it. Has never seen how it is computed.
rows.justRight: Opens the query, checks what it counts and what it drops, and then quotes it.
rows.over: Rebuilds every number from scratch and never gets to the decision.

rows.situation: When the data and the anecdote disagree
rows.under: Picks whichever one supports the plan.
rows.justRight: Treats the disagreement as a sign that the data is wrong or incomplete, and goes to find out which.
rows.over: Chases every anecdote to the bottom and lets the trend go unmanaged.

rows.situation: When an operator says the process does not work
rows.under: Explains the process back to them.
rows.justRight: Goes and watches the process run, then fixes what actually breaks.
rows.over: Moves into the operation and starts running it instead of the person who owns it.

rows.situation: When the work belongs to someone else
rows.under: Delegates and disappears, then finds out at the end.
rows.justRight: Knows the details well enough to ask the two questions that matter, then stays out of the way.
rows.over: Reviews every detail personally, and the owner becomes a messenger.

rows.under: Closes it once the alarm stops.
rows.justRight: Keeps asking why until the answer is something the team can change, then changes it.
rows.over: Runs a review so long that the same failure happens again during it.

rows.under: Waits for someone junior to pick it up.
rows.justRight: Picks it up. Reads the log, cleans the data, and works the shift.
rows.over: Spends every week on unglamorous fixes that one process change would have removed entirely.
